subject: Capacity margining & vendor handshake — OEM lead times + cloud backstop
messages:
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: emily.suzuki@gravitas-oem.com, jason.park@cloudbridge.io
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity margining & vendor handshake — OEM lead times + cloud backstop

Emily / Jason — following up from last week's sync. HaloMetrics is asking us to pin a dedicated capacity window for their Enterprise Dedicated pool tied to the D-2026-0734 commitment. Two constraints to align on before we finalize the MAP: (1) Gravitas OEM lead times: what is your current quoted ship window for the 8x A100-style SKUs we discussed? (2) CloudBridge backstop: what can you provide as an interim capacity backfill if OEM shipping slips beyond the quoted window?

Goal: define a pragmatic margining approach so the customer can start onboarding (QA + network tests) without waiting on full rack delivery. My current thinking: 12% margin on top of committed node count + a 3-month CloudBridge backstop tranche.

Questions for you both:
- Emily: can you confirm a committed manufacture slot or earliest ship-by quarter and any reservation cadence?
- Jason: can you outline the latency/throughput and cost delta for a 3-month backstop (reserved v. on-demand) and any minimum lead required to stand this up?

I've attached the draft MAP and the most recent HaloMetrics SOW for context (see attachments). Neha / Karthik — looping you for procurement and capacity planning input.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: MUTUALACTIONPLAN_HALOMETRICS.xlsx (draft), HALOMETRICS_SOW_v2.pdf
From: Emily Suzuki <emily.suzuki@gravitas-oem.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: jason.park@cloudbridge.io, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity margining & vendor handshake — OEM lead times + cloud backstop

Aditya — thanks for the clear ask. Quick summary from Gravitas: current production pipeline gives an earliest dock date of 2027-01-18 for the first tranche of the A100-equivalent blades, assuming the deposit is received by 2026-11-05. Two notes: (1) OEM quoting cadence is monthly; we can hold a slot for up to 30 days post-quote acceptance if a deposit is made, (2) quoted ETA variance +/- 3 weeks depending on component micro-shipments.

We can provide a formal reservation (non-refundable deposit) that guarantees allocation for the Q1 window; I'll attach an updated quote with a lead-time calendar and a list of components that are the current gating items. If HaloMetrics needs earlier capacity, Gravitas can coordinate a partial ship of networking-top-of-rack + half-rack compute in late Dec, but that will split the delivery over two SKUs and requires separate acceptance testing.

I'll upload HALOMETRICS_OEM_QUOTE_v3.pdf to the Drive link you shared by EOD.

—Emily
Emily Suzuki
Head of OEM Sales, Gravitas Systems
Attachments: HALOMETRICS_OEM_QUOTE_v3.pdf (quote, includes lead-time calendar)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: emily.suzuki@gravitas-oem.com, jason.park@cloudbridge.io
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Capacity margining & vendor handshake — OEM lead times + cloud backstop

Forwarding Emily's update. Key takeaways for procurement: Gravitas needs a deposit by 2026-11-05 to lock a Q1 slot. They offer split shipments if we want an early half-rack drop.

Neha — can you run two quick checks: (1) what margin on committed nodes do we recommend in the contract to cover the ETA variance (Emily flagged +/- 3 weeks but manufacturing variability can be larger), and (2) what's our preferred payment cadence to trigger the deposit while still leaving room for the customer to sign SOW terms?

Karthik — if we take the split-shipment route, do we have an internal operational plan to accept and stage a half-rack in a customer-dedicated staging pool? What are the networking prerequisites (cabling, ToR config) needed early?

Aditya
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: emily.suzuki@gravitas-oem.com, jason.park@cloudbridge.io
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 11:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Capacity margining & vendor handshake — action items on deposit & margining

Thanks Aditya — I recommend the following (procurement POV) prior to asking HaloMetrics to remit the deposit:
1) Margin rule: contract language to require a 10–15% operational margin on top of committed nodes for a 90-day provisioning window. Use 12% as standard for Tier-1 deals; this accommodates manufacturing variance and integration failures.
2) Deposit cadence: 30% deposit to secure slot, remainder split 50/50 (pre-shipment / post-acceptance). Make the deposit refundable only if Gravitas misses the agreed ship window by >21 days without a mitigation plan.
3) Contract clause: include an explicit split-shipment acceptance plan and an itemized list of early-delivery items; acceptance tests limited to smoke tests for early half-rack deliveries.

I'll draft redline language and push to the shared Drive. Also attaching a short procurement checklist for internal staging and customs holdbacks.

Neha Kapoor
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement
Redwood Inference
Attachments: procurement_staging_checklist.pdf
From: Jason Park <jason.park@cloudbridge.io>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: emily.suzuki@gravitas-oem.com, procurement@lumenedge.com, marta.ruiz@halometrics.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity margining & vendor handshake — CloudBridge backstop terms and practicals

Team — following up on the backstop ask. CloudBridge can provide a short-term reserved tranche sized at up to 20% of the committed node count for a maximum of 90 days. Summary of practicals:
- Latency: identical instance family to on-prem SKU within our Metal Edge footprint (single-digit p50 token latency overhead compared to native),
- Cost: 1.8x of Redwood Dedicated unit cost for reserved backstop (we can offer a capped not-to-exceed price if HaloMetrics signs a backstop addendum),
- Lead time to stand up: 48–72 hours from signed addendum and payment authorization (we can pre-stage images to shave this to 24 hours).

Operational notes: we will require an IP allocation and routing peering completed 72 hours prior to stand-up; early half-rack staging is compatible with our cross-connect provisioning but must be scheduled to avoid port contention. I've attached the CloudBridge backstop terms PDF.

If that aligns, we should add a short bulleted exhibit to the MAP that describes the 'Backstop Activation' trigger (e.g., 7-days after Gravitas confirms >14 day slip) and the invoicing cadence for the backstop tranche.

—Jason Park
Director, Edge Partnerships
CloudBridge (CloudBridge backstop terms attached)
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marta.ruiz@halometrics.ai, emily.suzuki@gravitas-oem.com, jason.park@cloudbridge.io
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, procurement@lumenedge.com
Date: Fri, 22 Oct 2026 17:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity margining & vendor handshake — next steps and MAP updates

Marta / HaloMetrics team — thanks for the patience. Quick plan and asks so we can close the MAP this week:
- We propose a 12% operational margin with a 30% deposit to Gravitas due 2026-11-03 to secure the Q1 slot.
- CloudBridge backstop addendum to be signed in parallel; activation trigger will be defined as an automatic option if Gravitas confirms a >14-day unplanned ship delay.
- Acceptance: split-shipment acceptance limited to smoke tests; final acceptance after full rack delivery and a 7-day production soak.

Next actions:
1) HaloMetrics: confirm you can authorize the deposit by 2026-11-03 and accept the proposed acceptance window.
2) Gravitas: Emily, please push the quote + deposit invoice to the DocuSign room (link above) and flag any gating components that could expand the ETA variance.
3) CloudBridge: Jason, please provide the one-page backstop exhibit we can append to the MAP.

If everyone agrees, I'll consolidate the three exhibits into the MAP and circulate a redline version by Monday.

Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: HALOMETRICS_OEM_QUOTE_v3.pdf, CloudBridge_backstop_terms_20261021.pdf, MUTUALACTIONPLAN_HALOMETRICS.xlsx
